description: Search npm for a need (e.g. 'date picker', 'markdown parser') and annotate each result with browser readiness for direct UNPKG file lookup: browser-ready ESM, CommonJS-only, or unclear, with the entry file and size when known. Ranking is npm's relevance order; readiness is annotated, never hidden, so a CJS-only result is visible as such rather than silently dropped.

query.description: What the package should do, e.g. 'confetti', 'sanitize html', 'date picker'.

name: search_packages
title: Search npm for browser-suitable packages
